## techqa_DEV_Q051#row-0039

Question:
We got a NullPointerException when bootstrapping the object store or accessing Site Preferences/Access Role on WorkplaceXT 

After logging into FileNet Workplace XT, a java.lang.NullPointerException error is logged when bootstrapping the object store or when accessing Site Preferences/Access Role.

Here's the error stack,

Error Stack Trace extracted from the J2EE Application Server error log:

java.lang.NullPointerException

at org.apache.jasper.runtime.JspWriterImpl.write(JspWriterImpl.java:421)

at com.filenet.wcm.apps.server.ui.info.prefs.PrefAccessRolesInfoPage.renderRoleMembers(PrefAccessRolesInfoPage.java:254)

at com.filenet.wcm.apps.server.ui.info.prefs.PrefAccessRolesInfoPage.renderRole(PrefAccessRolesInfoPage.java:220)

at com.filenet.wcm.apps.server.ui.info.prefs.PrefBootstrapInfoPage.renderAdminRole(PrefBootstrapInfoPage.java:131)

at com.filenet.wcm.apps.server.ui.info.prefs.PrefBootstrapInfoPage.render(PrefBootstrapInfoPage.java:303)

Reference / gold answer:
Based on the provided context, the NullPointerException occurring when bootstrapping the object store or accessing Site Preferences/Access Role on WorkplaceXT is likely caused by an invalid entry specified in the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute in the Directory Services Configuration in FileNet Enterprise Manager (FEM). To resolve the issue, you need to change the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute to a valid LDAP entry, such as cn, displayName or uid, in FEM and then restart the FileNet Content Engine and Workplace XT instances. This should prevent the NullPointerException error from occurring.

Reference evidence:
- `0a`: java.lang.NullPointerException; workplacext bootstrap; user display name TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING) PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
- `0b`:  After logging into FileNet Workplace XT, a java.lang.NullPointerException error is logged when bootstrapping the object store or when accessing Site Preferences/Access Role. SYMPTOM
- `0c`: Error Stack Trace extracted from the J2EE Application Server error log: java.lang.NullPointerException
- `0i`: This behavior may occur if an invalid entry has been specified in the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute setting in the Directory Services Configuration in FileNet Enterprise Manager (FEM).
- `0j`: Workplace XT attempts to resolve the user names and groups defined within the Access Roles based on the Directory Service configuration defined in FEM.
- `0k`: If the user name query resolves to null or if there is an invalid entry a NullPointerException error may occur.
- `0m`:  In FEM, change the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute to a valid LDAP entry such as cn, displayName or uid and restart the FileNet Content Engine and Workplace XT instances.

=== CANDIDATE A ===

- `E3.S7`: Error description
   The problematic scenario is when:
   (1) WebSphere Cloudburst Appliance is upgraded to version
   2.0.0.0
   (2) Then the new WebSphere Hypervisor Edition with the
   Intelligent Management Pack virtual image is imported, the
   license is accepted, and the Intelligent Management pack support
   is enabled.
   (3) Then when you attempt to drag and drop a  On demand router
   part onto the pattern. The pattern no longer can be displayed
   and a "Cannot invoke method toInteger( ) on null object"
   message is displayed.
- `E3.S8`: Local fix
   There is no workaround for this issue.
- `E3.S9`: Problem summary
   ****************************************************************
- `E3.S10`: * USERS AFFECTED:
   Users upgrading a WebSphere CloudBurst Appliance from releases
   prior to 2.0.0.0 to 2.0.0.0, who then import a new WebSphere
   Hypervisor Edition virtual image.
   ****************************************************************
- `E3.S11`: * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:
   In previous releases of WebSphere CloudBurst appliance, the On
   Demand Router part is no included. This is actually two parts,
   an abstract conceptual part, and a specific concrete"part
   associated with a particular WebSphere Hypervisor Edition
   virtual image. The upgrade from WebSphere CloudBurst 2.0.0.0
   does not add the conceptual part to the WebSphere CloudBurst
   Appliance. WebSphere CloudBurst Appliance is unable to construct
   a consistent pattern model, and the message "Cannot invoke
   method toInteger( ) on null object"  is the result.
   ****************************************************************
- `E3.S12`: Problem conclusion
   The WebSphere CloudBurst Appliance 2.0.0.1 upgrade includes the
   addition of the On Demand Router conceptual part to the
   WebSphere Cloudburst appliance.
   If this upgrade is applied, the problem is resolved.

   heap size by changing -Xmx value to -Xmx512M.

   WebSphere Application Server.

- `E1.S1`: ce health page; storage areas unavailable TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E1.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 The Content Engine Health Page (http://<CEserver>:<port>/P8CE/Health ) provides the status for different areas of the FileNet P8 system. When viewing the page, both the Fixed Content Devices and the Storage Areas may display red icons instead of checkmark green icons.
- `E1.S3`: SYMPTOM
Red icons are displayed next to the Fixed Content Devices and Storage Areas even though users can add and access content.
- `E1.S4`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
The p8_server_error log may contain the following E_ACCESS_DENIED error:
- `E1.S5`: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss nnnnnn ENG FNRCE0241E - ERROR method name: postLoadSecurity principal name: <username> Global Transaction: false User Transaction: false Exception Info: The requester has insufficient access rights to perform the requested operation.
com.filenet.api.exception.EngineRuntimeException: E_ACCESS_DENIED: The requester has insufficient access rights to perform the requested operation.
at com.filenet.engine.retrieve.IndependentClassRetriever.postLoadSecurity(IndependentClassRetriever.java:1390)
at com.filenet.engine.retrieve.RetrieverClassBase.loadNonScalarProperties(RetrieverClassBase.java:633)
at com.filenet.engine.retrieve.IndependentClassRetriever.loadNonScalarProperties(IndependentClassRetriever.java:1298)
at com.filenet.engine.retrieve.IndependentClassRetriever.loadObject(IndependentClassRetriever.java:1119)
...
- `E1.S6`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
- `E1.S7`: 1. Verify the Content Engine Bootstrap User has Full Control on the Object Store and all associated Storage Areas.
- `E1.S8`: 2. Inspect Storage Area security by right-clicking on the Object Store
- `E1.S9`: 3. Choose Properties
- `E1.S10`: 4. Select the All Properties radio button and view the Storage Area property name
- `E1.S11`: 5. Click on the drop down list to select the Storage Area.
- `E1.S12`: 6. The Storage Area properties screen will appear.
- `E1.S13`: 7. Verify the Security tab allows the Content Engine Bootstrap User has Full Control.

- `E4.S1`: CLOSE_WAIT; CORBA.NO_RESPONSE; iiop connection refused; ce client connection failed TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E4.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Attempts to connect to a P8 Content Engine from any CE client (e.g. ICN, ICM, Workplace, WorkplaceXT) or custom client application, result in connection failures.
- `E4.S3`: SYMPTOM
There may be a number of different errors depending on the client application. For example:
- `E4.S4`: The Repository is not available.
- `E4.S5`: failed to establish connection using iiop://<server>:port/FileNet/Engine
- `E4.S6`: CORBA.NO_RESPONSE
- `E4.S7`: WebSphere may report ORB thread starvation or multiple ORB hung threads, for example:-
- `E4.S8`: WSVR0606W: Thread "ORB.thread.pool : 90" (000000e0) was previously reported to be hung but has completed. It was active for approximately 1626228 milliseconds. There is/are 4 thread(s) in total in the server that still may be hung.
- `E4.S9`: CAUSE
Excessive load balancer health monitor calls against the default WebSphere EJB port may use all available ORB threads and may leave TCP connections in the CLOSE_WAIT state, resulting in connection failures from other clients.
- `E4.S10`: ENVIRONMENT
High availability IBM FileNet P8 Content Engine load balanced farm.
- `E4.S11`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
Check the WebSphere systemout.log for messages relating to hung threads or thread starvation.
Use netstat to collect information about port usage and remote connections.
Collect the load balancer health monitor configurations for all target P8 CE ports.
- `E4.S12`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
Review the following points in order to prevent this problem from occurring:
- `E4.S13`: * Avoid using a health monitor against the EJB/bootstrap port. 
 * The preferred load balancer health monitor for P8 Content Engine is to use the CE start-up context page, also known as the CE ping page. This should be configured against the HTTP port: 
   http://<<server>>:<<port>>/FileNet/Engine 
 * A typical load balancer HTTP health monitor configuration will only require the context path string:
   /FileNet/Engine 
 * The monitor interval should be set to the largest practical time interval, typically greater than 5 seconds. and a time-out value of not less than 15 seconds. 
 * The Content Engine application server instance will need to be re-started to close the accumulated open connections.

- `E5.S13`: Eclipse ant creates a different classloader to run the ant
   scripts. The problem is that with WID, the JRE contains xerces,
   during builds the plugins use the xerces plugin to load the
   xmls. The problem occurs when the is run on the main thread, the
   classloader does not pick up the xerces plugin rather uses the
   xerces that comes with the JRE, causing a class case exception
   that's wrapped in the CoreException.
- `E5.S14`: The solution is the create our own classloader that uses the
   plugin classloading first before loading the classes from the
   JRE.
- `E5.S15`: The code changes are in com.ibm.wbit.comptest.ant.
   There are 2 new classes RunAntWidPreferences.java and
   WidAntClassloader.java
   The RunAntWid.java class was updated to use those classes.

## techqa_DEV_Q205#row-0022

Question:
Launching IBM Rational Software Architect application results in Error: Java was started but returned exit code = -1 At times when you launch Rational Software Architect (RSA) application, you might encounter the following error: Error: Java was started but returned exit code = -1 

Reference / gold answer:
This error may indicate a problem with the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) when launching IBM Rational Software Architect. To resolve this issue, you can try updating the video driver to the newest version, as outdated or incompatible drivers can cause JVM termination errors. Another possible cause could be related to a bug in the Intel Graphic Card driver for Windows XP Service Pack 3. If updating the video driver does not solve the problem, you should contact Rational support for further assistance.

Reference evidence:
- `2b`:  This technote explains why opening workitem using IBM Rational Team Concert integrated with Rational Software Architect crashes with the error "JVM terminated.
- `2c`: Exit code=8096" .
- `2d`: It also provides instructions to resolve the issue. SYMPTOM

 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED: All users of WebSphere Extended Deployment   *
   *                 version 6.0.1.1.                             *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION: When  attempting to issue a             *
   *                      long-running scheduler command using    *
   *                      lrcmd.[bat|sh] through the On-Demand    *
   *                      Router (ODR), an IOException will be    *
   *                      returned as follows:                    *
   *                                                              *
   *                      C:\IBM\WebSphere\AppServer\bin>lrcmd    *
   *                      -cmd=submit -xJCL=C:\SimpleCIxJCL.xml   *
   *                      -port=<ODR port> -host=<ODR hostname>   *
   *                                                              *
   *                      CWLRB4940I: com.ibm.ws.batch.wsbatch :  *
   *                      -cmd=submit -xJCL=C:\SimpleCIxJCL.xml   *
   *                      -port=<ODR port> -host=<ODR hostname>   *
   *                                                              *
   *                      CWLRB4880E: -cmd=submit -xJCL=C:\Simple *
   *                      CIxJCL.xml -port=<ODR port>             *
   *                      -host=<ODR hostname> failed:            *
   *                      com.ibm.ws.batch.wsbatch: java.io.      *
   *                      IOException:Connection close: Read      *
   *                      failed.  Possible end of stream         *
   *                      encountered.                            *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   ****************************************************************
   The problem was caused by assuming in the code the every SOAP
   request will have a web module with web service and operation
   node defined. Therefore for the cases where web service and
   operation nodes do not exist, trying to use the operation map
   to get a key results in a null pointer exception. To the
   caller this wrapped up exception shows up as an IO Exception.
- `E1.S9`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  For each SOAP over HTTP request, check for the definition of
   web service and web service operation nodes, if they exist use
   them to fetch the workclasses and perform further request
   classification as necessary, otherwise, use the original
   request mapping to route request.
- `E1.S10`: TEMPORARY FIX

- `E3.S2`: Answer:
- `E3.S3`: The validation of your migration can be rerun. From the menu bar select Window > Show View > Other ... > Migration > Migration Results. When the view opens, click the green arrow.
- `E3.S4`: Version control and migration [javascript:void(0);] [javascript:void(0);] (click to expand) Question:
In previous versions of Rational Application Developer, you did not know which files should be released into your source code management system. Which files should be checked out when migrating in version 7.5?
- `E3.S5`: Answer:
- `E3.S6`: Rational Application Developer 7.5 now ensures that any file that needs to be modified is read/write before proceeding with migration.
- `E3.S7`: Note: Ideally, you should check out the entire project.
- `E3.S8`: On the Migration Project Resources page, you can see which files in the workspace will be modified by the migration process.
- `E3.S9`: To copy a the list of the files, right-click the list and click Select All, then right-click the list and click Copy.
- `E3.S10`: Restarting a failed migration [javascript:void(0);] [javascript:void(0);] (click to expand) Question:
The migration failed. Is there any way to restart the migration?
- `E3.S11`: Answer:
- `E3.S12`: Yes.
- `E3.S13`: Restart the workspace or close and reopen the project. Migration will start for any project that requires migration.
- `E3.S14`: Migration and start-up performance [javascript:void(0);] [javascript:void(0);] (click to expand) Question: 
In version 7.5, since migration runs at start-up, are there any performance issues when starting Rational Application Developer?
- `E3.S15`: Answer:
- `E3.S16`: No.
- `E3.S17`: There are no performance issues. Migration runs on a separate thread, is lightweight and does not block Rational Application Developer start-up.

   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   ****************************************************************
   The problem was caused by assuming in the code the every SOAP
   request will have a web module with web service and operation
   node defined. Therefore for the cases where web service and
   operation nodes do not exist, trying to use the operation map
   to get a key results in a null pointer exception. To the
   caller this wrapped up exception shows up as an IO Exception.
- `E4.S9`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  For each SOAP over HTTP request, check for the definition of
   web service and web service operation nodes, if they exist use
   them to fetch the workclasses and perform further request
   classification as necessary, otherwise, use the original
   request mapping to route request.

## techqa_DEV_Q239#row-0098

Question:
Cannot launch RFT 8.2 

Hello.

Could anyone can help to see why I cannot launch RFT 8.2? When I launch RFT. I get an error message--"An error has occurred. See the log file..." I check the log file. It shows

!SESSION Mon Nov 04 12:46:16 CST 2013 ------------------------------------------
!ENTRY org.eclipse.equinox.launcher 4 0 2013-11-04 12:46:16.359
!MESSAGE Exception launching the Eclipse Platform:
!STACK
java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: org.eclipse.core.runtime.adaptor.EclipseStarter
    at java.net.URLClassLoader.findClass(URLClassLoader.java:423)
    at java.lang.ClassLoader.loadClass(ClassLoader.java:653)
    at java.lang.ClassLoader.loadClass(ClassLoader.java:619)
    at org.eclipse.equinox.launcher.Main.invokeFramework(Main.java:616)
    at org.eclipse.equinox.launcher.Main.basicRun(Main.java:574)
    at org.eclipse.equinox.launcher.Main.run(Main.java:1407)
    at org.eclipse.equinox.launcher.Main.main(Main.java:1383)

If I launch RFT with -clean or -vm option, the same phenomenon occurs.

Reference / gold answer:
Based on the error message in the log file, it appears that the issue is related to a missing class "org.eclipse.core.runtime.adaptor.EclipseStarter" when launching RFT 8.2. This class is essential for launching the Eclipse Platform, which RFT is based on.

To resolve this issue, you can try the following steps based on the provided context:

1. Delete the user's .eclipse/ibm.software.delivery.platform_7.5.0_???? directory. You can do this by running the command:
   `rm -rf /home/yourusername/.eclipse/ibm.software.delivery.platform_7.5.0_????`

2. After deleting the directory, try relaunching RFT.

If the issue persists, you may need to further investigate and possibly update any necessary components or configurations for RFT to run successfully.

Reference evidence:
- `0b`:  When a eclipse based package is installed by an administrator and used by a non-administrator, out of date eclipse configuration cruft is left behind in the user's .eclipse/ folder that may affects the correct functioning of the currently installed package(s). SYMPTOM
- `0c`: The p2 based eclipse package does not start up correctly for non-administrator or it takes abnormal amount of time (10 minutes) to start up.
- `0q`: Delete the user's .eclipse/ibm.software.delivery.platform_7.5.0_???? directory. For example:
- `0r`: rm -rf /home/joe/.eclipse/ibm.software.delivery.platform_7.5.0_1529064711
- `0s`: Then relaunch the package.

- `E1.S13`: Eclipse ant creates a different classloader to run the ant
   scripts. The problem is that with WID, the JRE contains xerces,
   during builds the plugins use the xerces plugin to load the
   xmls. The problem occurs when the is run on the main thread, the
   classloader does not pick up the xerces plugin rather uses the
   xerces that comes with the JRE, causing a class case exception
   that's wrapped in the CoreException.
- `E1.S14`: The solution is the create our own classloader that uses the
   plugin classloading first before loading the classes from the
   JRE.
- `E1.S15`: The code changes are in com.ibm.wbit.comptest.ant.
   There are 2 new classes RunAntWidPreferences.java and
   WidAntClassloader.java
   The RunAntWid.java class was updated to use those classes.

- `E2.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Your Web browser throws a 404 "File not found" error when trying to reach a Web page. When reviewing the local.log for the ODR server located in install_root/logs/<ODR> directory, you see the following error:
- `E2.S3`: <ip address> - - [02/Nov/2004:21:42:40 -0500] "GET /FinancialAdvice/CpuAndSleepBound HTTP/1.1" 404 0
- `E2.S4`: Note: The following is the Web page that you were trying to reach:
http://<hostname/ip address>:83/FinancialAdvice/CpuAndSleepBound
- `E2.S5`: CAUSE
The reason for the 404 error can be determined by recreating and tracing the ODR server and application server.
Tracing the application server using the following trace string:
- `E2.S6`: Servlet_Engine=all=enabled 
Tracing the ODR server using the following trace string:
- `E2.S7`: com.ibm.ws.proxy.*=all=enabled 
The following outlines two scenarios causing the 404 error:  * Scenario 1 - User Error
   This scenario reviews a common problem where the user types an invalid URL for their application. Reviewing the ODR server trace.log we can see the request arrive and the error message returned from the application server:
- `E2.S8`: [11/2/04 20:46:47:297 EST] 67f1de90 HttpProxyServ < requestArrived - Received request; method=GET uri=/FinancialAdvice/CpuAndSleepBound service context=HttpProxyServiceContextImpl@4fb0de9d connection link=HttpProxyConnectionLink@3c415e9d
   ...
   [11/2/04 20:46:47:906 EST] 4f655e93 HttpProxyServ < responseArrived
   [11/2/04 20:46:47:906 EST] 4f655e93 HttpProxyConn d Status code=Status code: 404 response body allowed; service context=HttpProxyServiceContextImpl@4fb0de9d, connection link=HttpProxyConnectionLink@3c415e9d
   Reviewing the application server trace.log we can see the message arrive and the error message returned:
   [11/2/04 20:46:47:359 EST] 12d9f3a ServletReques > dispatchByURI
   /FinancialAdvice/CpuAndSleepBound
   ...
   [11/2/04 20:46:47:875 EST] 12d9f3a WebApp d Exception message=File not found: /CpuAndSleepBound
- `E2.S9`: * Scenario 2 - ODR Configuration
   This scenario reviews an ODR server configuration problem where an ODR server proxy port is not mapped to the appropriate virtual host. Reviewing the ODR server trace.log we can see the request arrive and then a 404 error because the ODR cannot properly map the request to an enterprise application:
- `E2.S10`: [11/2/04 21:42:40:156 EST] 6982e513 HttpProxyServ < requestArrived - Received request; method=GET uri=/FinancialAdvice/CpuAndSleepBound service context=HttpProxyServiceContextImpl@5d426517 connection link=HttpProxyConnectionLink@5cd52517
   ...
   [11/2/04 21:42:40:156 EST] 6982e513 MapRequestFil d failed to map request to application: com.ibm.ws.http.channel.impl.HttpRequestMessageImpl@4a56515
   ...
   [11/2/04 21:42:40:172 EST] 6982e513 HttpFilterCha d Filter=HTTP Mapper generated error status code=Status code: 404 for service context=HttpProxyServiceContextImpl@5d426517. Generating error response and breaking request chaining.
- `E2.S11`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
The following are the two solutions to the preceding scenarios.
- `E2.S12`: * Scenario 1 - User Error Solution
   Review the EAR file to determine the correct urls and if the url used above is valid. From the application.xml you can find the context root for the Web modules. Find the Web module, FinancialAdvice.war, that corresponds to the FinancialAdvice context root, shown below:
- `E2.S13`: <web-uri>FinancialAdvice.war</web-uri>
   <context-root>/FinancialAdvice</context-root> 
   From the web.xml file for the FinancialAdvice.war we can find all valid url patterns for the application. You should find the following if this was a valid URL: 
   <url-pattern>/CpuAndSleepBound</url-pattern> 
   But for this scenario, you would not find the preceeding xml entry in the web.xml because the Web page URL was invalid.
- `E2.S14`: * Scenario 2 - ODR Configuration Solution
   The proxy port setting for the ODR is not mapped to the appropriate virtual host group. This can be done using the administrative console:  1. Find the ODR proxy http  1. Expand the Servers topology 
        2.

- `E5.S2`: ABSTRACT
 IBM hosted an Open Mic Webcast with Lotus Development and Support Engineers on 28 September 2011. The topic was "IBM Lotus Notes in Citrix XenApp environments." Check back for the Q&A transcript.
- `E5.S3`: CONTENT
- `E5.S4`: For more information about our Open Mic webcasts, visit the IBM Collaboration Solutions Support Open Mics [http://www.ibm.com/software/lotus/support/lotus-open-mics/] page.
- `E5.S5`: Presentation & Audio Recording 
Presentation 
[/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27022065&aid=2]OpenMic_NotesCitrix_09_28_2011.pdf [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27022065&aid=1]
- `E5.S6`: Audio recording 
Lotus_Notes_on_Citrix_XenApp_OpenMic_Sept282011.mp3 [ftp://public.dhe.ibm.com/software/lotus/info/notes/Lotus_Notes_on_Citrix_XenApp_OpenMic_Sept282011.mp3]
- `E5.S7`: Q&A 
Q. Since ID Vault is not supported in Citrix environments until Notes 8.5.3, does that mean it’s known to not work in prior versions? 
A. The statement about support of 8.5.3 just implies that we tested it formally in 8.5.3 and that no testing has been done on previous releases. It doesn’t mean that if used prior to 8.5.3 you’ll find any issues or that there are functional issues with it.
- `E5.S8`: Q. I’m planning to upgrade a Notes installation on a Presentation Server 4.5 from Notes 7.0.2 to 8.5.2 Fix Pack 1. Any advice or pitfalls or best practices we should be aware of prior to doing that? Is an upgrade preferable or a clean install? 
A . With 7.0.2 you should have had the Single User Install because we didn’t support multi-user until 8.5.1, so I would recommend uninstalling Notes 7.x and then doing an install of Notes 8.5.1 or 8.5.2. Then, any subsequent upgrades you could just do an in-place upgrade without backing out the previous build.
- `E5.S9`: Q.Intermittently, users are not able to log in and we receive an error message that “the Administration program could not be used while the Domino server is running”. 
A. I’ve found that if users completely terminate their ICA session that will leave Notes running in their session. And when the user tries to launch Notes again the error will occur.
- `E5.S10`: If you’re publishing it as an application, advise users to do a File > Exit to cleanly close the ICA session and to avoid leaving ghost sessions on the XenApp server. You may also want to check with Citrix to see if they have suggestions on handling cases where ICA sessions are terminated but the processes are still running.
- `E5.S11`: Q. Regarding the recommendation to leverage file server roaming capability where possible, is Domino roaming preferred for that versus Domino file server roaming? For example we want to implement using Domino server because we think it’s easier and we’ve already got a connection established to the mail server to roam to that server, but in the presentation the recommendation was to leverage file server roaming. 
A. You can use either one. The presentation focused on file server roaming because you can implement it using a policy and you don’t need to have a Domino application installed on that server in order to set it up as a roaming server.

- `E5.S7`: Error description
   The problematic scenario is when:
   (1) WebSphere Cloudburst Appliance is upgraded to version
   2.0.0.0
   (2) Then the new WebSphere Hypervisor Edition with the
   Intelligent Management Pack virtual image is imported, the
   license is accepted, and the Intelligent Management pack support
   is enabled.
   (3) Then when you attempt to drag and drop a  On demand router
   part onto the pattern. The pattern no longer can be displayed
   and a "Cannot invoke method toInteger( ) on null object"
   message is displayed.
- `E5.S8`: Local fix
   There is no workaround for this issue.
- `E5.S9`: Problem summary
   ****************************************************************
- `E5.S10`: * USERS AFFECTED:
   Users upgrading a WebSphere CloudBurst Appliance from releases
   prior to 2.0.0.0 to 2.0.0.0, who then import a new WebSphere
   Hypervisor Edition virtual image.
   ****************************************************************
- `E5.S11`: * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:
   In previous releases of WebSphere CloudBurst appliance, the On
   Demand Router part is no included. This is actually two parts,
   an abstract conceptual part, and a specific concrete"part
   associated with a particular WebSphere Hypervisor Edition
   virtual image. The upgrade from WebSphere CloudBurst 2.0.0.0
   does not add the conceptual part to the WebSphere CloudBurst
   Appliance. WebSphere CloudBurst Appliance is unable to construct
   a consistent pattern model, and the message "Cannot invoke
   method toInteger( ) on null object"  is the result.
   ****************************************************************
- `E5.S12`: Problem conclusion
   The WebSphere CloudBurst Appliance 2.0.0.1 upgrade includes the
   addition of the On Demand Router conceptual part to the
   WebSphere Cloudburst appliance.
   If this upgrade is applied, the problem is resolved.

## techqa_DEV_Q095#row-0032

Question:
Why do I get error when I try to save application in APMUI? I am using APMUI 7.7 IF1. Following error occurs when I try to save application:

 

CTGAZ0001E: The application cannot be saved because the application repository is not available.
messages.log of scr server shows that it is listening at 17310 port:

 

A CWWKT0016I: Web application available (default_host): http://apmhost:17310/SCRCLUSTER_SCR_oslc.html
But apmui is referring to this URL with port 8080 (APM_UI.log):

 

http://apmhost:8080/SCRCLUSTER_SCR_oslc/scr/gettime

Reference / gold answer:
The error occurs because the APMUI application is trying to save the application using the wrong port. It is attempting to access the SCRCLUSTER_SCR_oslc.html URL with port 8080 instead of the correct port 17310. This discrepancy is causing the "CTGAZ0001E: The application cannot be saved because the application repository is not available" error message to appear. To resolve this issue, you need to ensure that APMUI is configured to access the SCRCLUSTER_SCR_oslc.html URL with the correct port 17310 instead of port 8080.

   The proxy port setting for the ODR is not mapped to the appropriate virtual host group. This can be done using the administrative console:  1. Find the ODR proxy http  1. Expand the Servers topology 
        2. Select the On Demand Routers entry. 
        3. Under Additional Properties select the End Points.

From the serverindex.xml file you can find the http proxy address used by the ODR. This port was used in the url by the user to hit the ODR so it can route the request to the running server.

- `E3.S1`: TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E3.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 When I run a DVS test from RTS, I get the following error: "Host and port appear to be responsive but the service "/testing/repositoryService" does not exist."
- `E3.S3`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
- `E3.S4`: This might be due to user errors in configuration. For example, you could have set the URL of the Rule Execution Server to be 'http://<host>:<port>/testing' instead of 'http://<host>:<port>/res" in the RTS configuration.
- `E3.S5`: . When you add a new server to the RTS configuration ( Websphere ILOG Rule Team Server online help > Configure: Manage your project configuration > Managing servers [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/brdotnet/v7r0m2/index.jsp?topic=/com.ibm.websphere.ilog.brdotnet.doc/Content/Business_Rules/Documentation/_pubskel/Rules_for_DotNET/ps_RFDN_Global716.html]), make sure you specify the URL of the Rule Execution Server (e.g.: http://localhost:8080/res).
- `E3.S6`: A common mistake is to specify the URL of the SSP server (e.g.: http://localhost:8080/testing), which leads to the error above.
- `E3.S7`: This error could also indicate that the SSP is not correctly deployed or configured.
- `E3.S8`: Please check that the SSP is correctly deployed and configured.
- `E3.S9`: Examine the application server logs for error messages which indicate the root of the problem. For example, you could have multiple SSPs deployed and different XOMs integrated into different SSPs. In that case, make sure that you have one SSP deployed and active, and all the XOMs are integrated within it.
- `E3.S10`: Also note that the SSP and the RES management console are expected to be deployed on the same server outside the cluster, and no other SSP should be deployed inside the cluster, See Clustering Decision Validation Services [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21425487] for more details.
- `E3.S11`: If these recommendations do not help, please contact IBM support with a description of your set up and the server logs.
- `E3.S12`: Cross reference information Segment Product Component Platform Version Edition Business Integration IBM Operational Decision Manager Platform Independent 8.6, 8.5, 8.0, 7.5 Enterprise

- `E4.S8`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED: All users of WebSphere Extended Deployment   *
   *                 version 6.0.1.1.                             *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION: When  attempting to issue a             *
   *                      long-running scheduler command using    *
   *                      lrcmd.[bat|sh] through the On-Demand    *
   *                      Router (ODR), an IOException will be    *
   *                      returned as follows:                    *
   *                                                              *
   *                      C:\IBM\WebSphere\AppServer\bin>lrcmd    *
   *                      -cmd=submit -xJCL=C:\SimpleCIxJCL.xml   *
   *                      -port=<ODR port> -host=<ODR hostname>   *
   *                                                              *
   *                      CWLRB4940I: com.ibm.ws.batch.wsbatch :  *
   *                      -cmd=submit -xJCL=C:\SimpleCIxJCL.xml   *
   *                      -port=<ODR port> -host=<ODR hostname>   *
   *                                                              *
   *                      CWLRB4880E: -cmd=submit -xJCL=C:\Simple *
   *                      CIxJCL.xml -port=<ODR port>             *
   *                      -host=<ODR hostname> failed:            *
   *                      com.ibm.ws.batch.wsbatch: java.io.      *
   *                      IOException:Connection close: Read      *
   *                      failed.  Possible end of stream         *
   *                      encountered.                            *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   ****************************************************************
   The problem was caused by assuming in the code the every SOAP
   request will have a web module with web service and operation
   node defined. Therefore for the cases where web service and
   operation nodes do not exist, trying to use the operation map
   to get a key results in a null pointer exception. To the
   caller this wrapped up exception shows up as an IO Exception.
- `E4.S9`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  For each SOAP over HTTP request, check for the definition of
   web service and web service operation nodes, if they exist use
   them to fetch the workclasses and perform further request
   classification as necessary, otherwise, use the original
   request mapping to route request.

   - Issue the following commands

   -repositories http://IBMWorkloadDeployer:8585/IMRepository/Compo [http://IBMWorkloadDeployer:8585/IMRepository/Compo]

   available, also issue
- `E2.S15`: sudo -u virtuser ./imcl listAvailableFixes <fix-name>
   -repositories http://<external-IM-repository> [http://<external-IM-repository>]
- `E2.S16`: where <fix-name> is the name of the fix to be applied, and
   <external-IM-repository>  is the URL for the external IM
   repository.

   - Wait 2 hours

   - Provide the trace.zip file to IBM support

   - Review the Kernel Services logs for log entries from

   maintenance, fix). The Java fix had an unhandled version
   format.

 *  A code fix is being provided in PureApplication System version
   2.2.0.0.

- `E5.S3`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
- `E5.S4`: 1. From the application server console, check if the application EAR files for the Decision Center and the RES Management are deployed and have been started.
- `E5.S5`: 2. From the application server administration console, check the HTTP port number. Make sure you use this port number to access the console. For example, by default, the HTTP port number for WebSphere Application Server is 9080, but it might be configured to 9081 for the profile on which the ODM application is installed.
- `E5.S6`: 3. Check that the HTTP port is not being used [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21264632] by another process. If it is, stop the other process and try to access the console again.
- `E5.S7`: 4. Examine the server logs. If they contain the following exception:
- `E5.S8`: com.ibm.ws.webcontainer.webapp.WebApp logServletError SRVE0293E: 
[Servlet Error]-[/moduleVersion/versioninfo.jsp]: 
com.ibm.ws.jsp.translator.JspTranslationException: JSPG0227E: Exception 
caught while translating /moduleVersion/versioninfo.jsp: 
java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException at 
com.ibm.ws.jsp.translator.JspTranslator.processVisitors(JspTranslator.java:139) at 
com.ibm.ws.jsp.translator.utils.JspTranslatorUtil.translateJsp(JspTranslatorUtil.java:254) at 
com.ibm.ws.jsp.translator.utils.JspTranslatorUtil.translateJspAndCompile(JspTranslatorUtil.java:121) at com.ibm.ws.jsp.webcontainerext.AbstractJSPExtensionServletWrapper.translateJsp(AbstractJSPExtensionServletWrapper.java:548)
- `E5.S9`: Ensure that the <WAS_install>/temp and <WAS_profile>/temp directories have sufficient read and write privileges for the non-root user. If possible, grant the user full access to the entire application server installation directory. Note that on Windows, you can check if you have the required privileges by right-clicking on the folder, choosing Properties, and going to the Security tab.
- `E5.S10`: Also ensure there are no JSP files which were compiled by another user in the above-mentioned directories.
- `E5.S11`: This error could also be due to the APAR PI09545 [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg1PI09545], in which case apply the appropriate fix.
- `E5.S12`: 5. Ensure there are no firewall settings which are preventing access to the Decision Center or Rule Execution Server consoles.
- `E5.S13`: 6. Ensure that the Class loader order property is set to Classes loaded with local class loader first (parent last), for the ILOG Rule Execution Server Console module of the Rule Execution Server EAR. See Step 17 of the documentation at 
Operational Decision Manager V8.5.1 > Configuring > Configuring Operational Decision Manager on WebSphere Application Server > Configuring Rule Execution Server on WebSphere Application Server [http://pic.dhe.ibm.com/infocenter/dmanager/v8r5m1/index.jsp?topic=%2Fcom.ibm.odm.distrib.config.was%2Fconfig_ds_res_was8%2Ftsk_was_deploy_mgmt_ear.html]

## techqa_DEV_Q077#row-0008

Question:
I need to transfer my SPSS 24 licence to a new computer I need to transfer my SPSS 24 license to a new machine. I have only used my activation code on one computer so far, and that computer was found to be defective which has led me to get a new computer. I was able to download SPSS 24 Gradpack onto the new computer, but every time I put in the activation code, the program gives me an error message saying that I am not allowed to generate any new licenses.

Reference / gold answer:
To transfer your SPSS 24 license to a new computer, you will need to follow these steps:

1. Contact IBM SPSS support for assistance with transferring your license. You can find support contact information on the IBM SPSS website or through the vendor from whom you purchased your license (e.g. Hearne, On the Hub, StudentDiscounts.com, JourneyEd, thinkEDU, Studica).

2. Explain your situation to the support representative, indicating that your previous computer was defective and you are trying to transfer your license to a new computer.

3. Provide the support representative with your activation code and any other relevant information they may require to verify your license.

4. The support representative should be able to assist you in deactivating the license from your old computer and activating it on your new computer.

5. Follow any instructions provided by the support representative to successfully transfer your SPSS 24 license to your new machine.

By following these steps and contacting IBM SPSS support, you should be able to resolve the issue with the error message you are receiving when trying to activate the license on your new computer.

- `E4.S4`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  When you place your inbound web service  inside a toolkit and
   one parameter is defined as a complex type list, the inbound
   web service generated WSDL contains an array type definition
   in a non-existent namespace and the runtime-generated SOAP
   message does not accomplish the WSDL definition. As a result,
   the web service client reports an error when loading the wrong
   WSDL or parsing the SOAP response message.

- `E4.S8`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:  IBM Business Process Manager (BPM)          *
   *                  Advanced                                    *
   *                  IBM BPM Express                             *
   *                  IBM BPM Standard                            *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION: When you place your inbound web         *
   *                      service  inside a toolkit and one       *
   *                      parameter is defined as a complex       *
   *                      type list, the inbound web service      *
   *                      generated WSDL contains an array type   *
   *                      definition in a non-existent            *
   *                      namespace and the runtime-generated     *
   *                      SOAP message does not accomplish the    *
   *                      WSDL definition. As a result, the web   *
   *                      service client reports an error when    *
   *                      loading the wrong WSDL or parsing the   *
   *                      SOAP response message.                  *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   ****************************************************************
   When you put the inbound web service inside a toolkit, the
   WSDL might use the namespace of the toolkit instead of the
   process application namespace. As a result, the array list
   items are created with the wrong namespace and wrong WSDL and
   a wrong SOAP message are generated.
- `E4.S9`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.5.0 that ensures the
   correct namespace is used no matter where the web service is
   placed.

- `E2.S15`: DEFINITIONS
Regression: An error in the Maintenance Delivery Vehicle [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27008656] (MDV) that produces incorrect or unexpected behavior causing a supported feature to stop functioning as designed. 
This includes:
- `E2.S16`: * Coding errors that cause a regression
 * Documentation or packaging problems that cause a regression
 * Errors reported in a new function delivered in a MDV that cause a regression
- `E2.S17`: Incomplete: An error in the MDV has not regressed, but does not work as designed. 
This includes:
- `E2.S18`: * Fixed APARs which did not solve the original problem but did not break anything new
 * APARs reporting documentation errors, such as readme errors, that cause problems applying an MDV but do not lead to a regression
- `E2.S19`: Notes:  * Regression and incomplete APARs are considered fix-in-error or MDV-in-error
 * Definitions above apply only to valid APARs that result in product fixes (APARs returned as working-as-designed are not assessed for being fix-in-error)
 * Issues in major releases due to new functionality do not apply in this definition

- `E4.S1`: TECHNOTE (FAQ)
- `E4.S2`: QUESTION
 How can I make use of the WebSphere MQ Read Ahead functionality from an application that uses the WebSphere MQ classes for JMS to create a subscription on a topic, and then synchronously receives messages that are published on that topic?
- `E4.S3`: ANSWER
WebSphere MQ V7 introduced a new feature called "Read Ahead [http://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/en/SSFKSJ_8.0.0/com.ibm.mq.dev.doc/q026310_.htm]". This performance optimization allows WebSphere MQ queue managers to stream non-persistent messages to client applications connecting via TCP/IP before the application has requested them. The client stores these messages in a Read Ahead Buffer. When an application requests a message, the client removes the message from the buffer and gives it to the application for processing.
JMS applications running in one of the following environments:
- `E4.S4`: * The WebSphere MQ classes for JMS. 
 * The WebSphere MQ Resource Adapter. 
 * The WebSphere MQ OSGi bundles.
- `E4.S5`: that connect to a WebSphere MQ queue manager using the CLIENT transport in WebSphere MQ messaging provider normal mode, [http://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/en/SSFKSJ_8.0.0/com.ibm.mq.connect.doc/intro_jms_msgprov.htm] and receive messages synchronously, can make use of the new functionality.
- `E4.S6`: This technote will look at how applications that subscribe to a topic need to be written in order to take advantage of the Read Ahead functionality, as well as discussing what JMS Destination and WebSphere MQ properties need to be set to turn on Read Ahead.
- `E4.S7`: Applications running within an WebSphere Application Server environment can also make use of this functionality. Details of how to do this will be covered in a future technote.
- `E4.S8`: Writing a JMS application to use Read Ahead to receive messages synchronously 
The Read Ahead feature will only stream non-persistent messages to client applications that are getting messages outside of a transaction.
- `E4.S9`: In JMS terms, this means that the application must be using a non-transacted JMS session that has an acknowledgement mode of either AUTO_ACKNOWLEDGE or DUPS_OK_ACKNOWLEDGE in order to be eligible to make use of Read Ahead.
- `E4.S10`: Here is an example which shows an application creating a non-transacted, AUTO_ACKNOWLEDGE JMS Session: 
 *
- `E4.S11`: The non-transacted JMS Session can then be used to create a MessageConsumer object for the JMS Destination that maps to the WebSphere MQ topic which the non-persistent messages will be published on.
- `E4.S12`: Once the MessageConsumer has been created, applications that get non-persistent messages by calling one of the following methods: 
 * 
 * 
 * 
 * 
 *
- `E4.S13`: will be eligible to make use of Read Ahead, if the JMS Destination and the WebSphere MQ topic that the Destination maps to allows this functionality.
- `E4.S14`: Configuring the JMS Destination and WebSphere MQ to allow Read Ahead 
When an application uses the WebSphere MQ classes for JMS to subscribe to a WebSphere MQ topic, a managed subscription will be created. This managed subscription will either be durable or non-durable, depending upon how the application created the subscription.
- `E4.S15`: With managed subscriptions, the WebSphere MQ Publish/Subscribe Engine will create a managed queue for the application. Every time a message is published on the WebSphere MQ topic that the application has subscribed to, the WebSphere MQ Publish/Subscribe Engine will take a copy of that message and put it onto the managed queue.

## techqa_DEV_Q032#row-0062

Question:
IBM Content Navigator v2.0.3 is adding a .dat extension to a CSV file during Download action on a document. IBM Content Navigator v2.0.3 is adding a .dat extension to a CSV file during Download action on a document. Why is this the case?

Reference / gold answer:
The reason the IBM Content Navigator v2.0.3 is adding a .dat extension to a CSV file during the download action on a document is that if the mime type of the document as shown in system properties in ICN is not text/csv, then Navigator cannot recognize the document properly, resulting in adding the .dat extension during download. The correct mime type for a CSV file should be text/csv.

Reference evidence:
- `4b`:  IBM Content Navigator v2.0.3 is adding a .dat extension to a CSV document during Download action on the document. SYMPTOM
- `4c`: A .dat extension is added to the CSV document upon download. CAUSE
- `4d`: A CSV document is basically a plain text file.
- `4e`: If the mime type of the document as shown in system properties in ICN is not text/csv, then Navigator cannot recognize the document and a .dat extension will be added upon download.
- `4f`: The correct mime type for a CSV file is text/csv.

=== CANDIDATE A ===

- `E2.S21`: Fixed issues 
The following issues are fixed in IBM Datacap 9.1.3, Interim Fix 2: Datacap application/component Description Datacap Navigator Spaces contained in variable value get trimmed after the variable value is saved page file. On the Settings page, under the Job Monitor tab, the "Sort by" feature does not remain consistent. Asynchronous upload progress bar and batch status does not map. Validation fails on empty Date fields on the Chrome browser. Index, Verify document, and page labels are not displayed correctly when document and page labels are defined in PageID. The Batch preparation client does not open after launching web scan client. When you close task quickly, a "Missing JavaScript Event handler" error might occur. Services Operation error has been recorded in the "tms.log" file of the Datacap Server. Datacap Desktop The Merge Document feature for fails in Datacap Desktop. Datacap Desktop unexpectedly terminates on batch load. DotEdit, DotScan and FastDoc do not report proper elapsed time in the statistics table. The Verify panel throws an "Object Reference" error when a required page is missing from the document, and when validation occurs on the Main_Page. Multiselect drag and drop in thumbnail view does not highlight the thumbnail that is target of drop. Additional Task Profile, created in tmweb, is disabled, and does not work in Datacap Desktop. IBM Datacap Insight Edition (Document Analytics) Most of the pages that are classified using the VisualRecog action have an empty type associated with them. Datacap Web Client For operational shortcut in the tmweb for the "Manual for hold" mode, after clicking the select pending Datacap, does not process the oldest batch first.
- `E3.S1`: WMB IIB SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E3.S2`: SUMMARY
 WebSphere Message Broker and IBM Integration Bus using the IBM Dojo Toolkit and providing the dojox/form/resources/fileuploader.swf, dojox/form/resources/uploader.swf, dojox/av/resources/audio.swf or dojox/av/resources/video.swf files are subjected to a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability.
- `E3.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID:CVE-2014-8917 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2014-8917]
DESCRIPTION: IBM Dojo Toolkit is vulnerable to cross-site scripting, caused by improper validation of user-supplied input. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability using a specially-crafted URL to execute scripts in a victim's Web browser within the security context of the hosting Web site, when the URL is clicked. An attacker could use this vulnerability to steal the victim's cookie-based authentication credentials
CVSS Base Score: 4.3
CVSS Temporal Score: Seehttp://xforce.iss.net/xforce/xfdb/99303 [http://xforce.iss.net/xforce/xfdb/99303] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: AV:N/AC:M/Au:N/C:N/I:P/A:N
- `E3.S4`: AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
IBM WebSphere Message Broker V8
- `E3.S5`: IBM Integration Bus V9
- `E3.S6`: REMEDIATION/FIXES
Follow the steps outlined in the workarounds and mitigations section.
APAR IT06833 is targeted for availability in WebSphere Message Broker V8.0.0.6 and IBM Integration Bus V9.0.0.4 which will remove the affected files.
- `E3.S7`: WORKAROUNDS AND MITIGATIONS
The files affected by this vulnerability are not used by the WebSphere Message Broker or IBM Integration Bus web user interface (web UI) and can be deleted.

- `E4.S2`: QUESTION

The ACCE interface arranges objects differently than FEM, and users may have trouble finding some objects/directories in ACCE.

 The DiskFileItem class in Apache Commons Fileupload before 1.3.3, as used in Control Center, could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code under current context of the current process causing an undefined behavior.
- `E5.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVE-ID: CVE-2016-1000031 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2016-1000031]
Description: Apache Commons FileUpload, as used in Novell NetIQ Sentinel, could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the system, caused by deserialization of untrusted data in DiskFileItem class of FileUpload library. A attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the current process.

 This document describes how to download IBM WebSphere Application Server for Developers Version 7.0 for Windows installation images from the IBM Passport Advantage Online Web site.
- `E2.S3`: CONTENT
IBM WebSphere Application Server is the premier Java™ Platform, Enterprise Edition (Java EE) and Web services-based application server. WebSphere Application Server is built on open standards and helps you deploy and manage applications ranging from simple Web sites to powerful on-demand solutions.

- `E2.S6`: * 800 MB of disk space to store the required downloadable parts plus 900 MB of disk space to unpack the parts. 
 * 1 GB (1000 MB) of disk space to install the product without profiles and 1.25 GB (1250 MB) for a cell installation. 
 * 30 MB of space in the tmp directory to run the installation program. 
 * For more detailed information, see the WebSphere Application Server detailed system requirements [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=180&uid=swg27006921] document.

 2. Select the Find by part number search option under Download finder options. 
 3. Search for each downloadable image by part number. 
 4. Download all of the required parts. 
 5. Use a file extracting utility that supports large file extractions to unpack each of the parts into a single, temporary directory on your system. 
 6. Open the Quick Start Guide, which is located on the Quick Start CD. Follow step three through step nine of the Quick Start Guide to access the documentation to help with product installation.

- `E3.S4`: APAR STATUS
 * CLOSED AS PROGRAM ERROR.
- `E3.S5`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  When a storage area becomes offline or unavailable, ingested
   documents are created unfiled and with minor version number.
- `E3.S6`: This is occurring because the Content Engine (CE) Client
   (WorkplaceXT (WPXT), etc) is not able
   to delete or remove the document after an unsuccessful call to
   the document.setContent(...) method due to no storage area being
   available.
- `E3.S7`: LOCAL FIX
- `E3.S8`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:                                              *
   * Using ICC or WorkplaceXT for document ingestion with         *
   * 5.0.0.2-P8CE-FP002 or prior.                                 *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:                                         *
   * When using ICC or WorkplaceXT for document ingestion, if the *
   * target storage area happens to be unavailable (due to        *
   * hardware, network issues, etc) the applications would create *
   * minor versions of documents without content, not the         *
   * expected major versions with content.  These minor versions  *
   * could not be deleted until the storage area was back online, *
   * making it impossible for the ingestion applications to       *
   * correctly clean up their incomplete work.                    *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   * Upgrade to Content Engine 5.0.0.3-P8CE-FP003 or later, and   *
   * upgrade the ingestion application to a version that          *
   * implements cleanup of incomplete documents.                  *
   ****************************************************************
- `E3.S9`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  Code fix in Content Engine 5.0.0.3-P8CE-FP003 or later will
   allow the ingestion applications to clean up incomplete
   ingestion in this case.
   Note that the ingestion applications me require modification to
   actually perform the cleanup.

## techqa_DEV_Q172#row-0018

Question:
What's the procedure to drop an user in Cognos Disclosure Management? 

O.S AIX 7.1

Cognos Disclosure Management 10.2.4 What's the procedure to drop an user in Cognos Disclosure Management

Reference / gold answer:
Based on the provided context, the procedure to drop a user in Cognos Disclosure Management version 10.2.4 is as follows:

1. Upgrade to Cognos Disclosure Management version 10.2.5 if possible, as this version introduces a "Custom" option field that allows users to input any required Reference Date.
2. If upgrading is not possible, contact CDM support for further assistance in dropping a user.

Alternatively, if you are looking for instructions on how to delete a user in the Cognos Disclosure Management application, you should refer to the official documentation or user guide provided by IBM for detailed instructions on how to manage users within the application.

- `E1.S1`: TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E1.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 A user account that was originally created in the IBM Sterling B2B Integrator (SBI) user interface was assigned an IBM Sterling File Gateway (SFG) partner's Identity in the user account. When that user account logs in to My File Gateway and clicks on the dropdown arrow for the Mailbox Path field on the Upload Files tab, there are a number of mailboxes showing instead of just the main mailbox of the SFG partner.
- `E1.S3`: SYMPTOM
Multiple, unrelated mailboxes appear as options in the dropdown list for the Mailbox Path field of the Upload Files tab in My File Gateway
- `E1.S4`: CAUSE
There are two parts to the cause. The first part is that at least one of the groups of which the User Account is a member has permissions to specific mailboxes. Those are the extra mailboxes showing in the dropdown list. The other part is that, as the user account was not created automatically by creating a partner in the SFG user interface, no virtual root was automatically assigned to it, so it shows every mailbox that the user account has permissions to either directly or through its group memberships.
- `E1.S5`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
There are two choices to resolve the problem. Choose the one that best fits your needs.
- `E1.S6`: Option 1: Create a virtual root for the user account. The advantage to this method is it is specific to the user account. The potential disadvantage is that the user account will only have access to its virtual root mailbox and its sub-mailboxes, even if it needs access to some of the other mailboxes. Create the virtual root by doing the following:
- `E1.S7`: 1. Edit the user account and write down the value in the Identity field. For this example, assume it is Partner537. 
 2. Go to Deployment > Mailboxes > Virtual Roots in the SBI menu. 
 3. Create a virtual root using /Partner537 as the mailbox.
- `E1.S8`: Option 2: Remove the specific mailbox permissions in all groups that the user account is a member of. The advantage to this is it will likely allow you to take care of multiple user accounts in one process. The potential disadvantage is that if any of the members of that group really do need access to all of the mailboxes that the group specifically has permissions to, they will lose them. Change the groups' permissions by doing the following:
- `E1.S9`: 1. Edit the User account and write down all the items showing in the Assigned box of the Groups screen, then click Cancel. 
 2. Go to Accounts > Groups in the SBI menu. 
 3. Type the name of one of the groups written down above in the Group Name field and click Go! 
 4. Click "edit" 
 5. Click the Next button until you are at the Assign Permissions screen. 
 6. Remove all mailbox entries from the Assigned box, then click Save. 
 7. Click Finish. 
 8. Repeat steps 3-7 for all the other groups that the user account is a member of.
- `E1.S10`: NOTE: No method exists for leaving the specific permissions in the groups, but also giving the user account access through My File Gateway to two or more mailboxes that have only the root mailbox as a common ancestor.
- `E1.S11`: Click "edit" 
 5. Click the Next button until you are at the Assign Permissions screen. 
 6. Remove all mailbox entries from the Assigned box, then click Save. 
 7. Click Finish. 
 8. Repeat steps 3-7 for all the other groups that the user account is a member of.
- `E1.S12`: NOTE: No method exists for leaving the specific permissions in the groups, but also giving the user account access through My File Gateway to two or more mailboxes that have only the root mailbox as a common ancestor.

- `E4.S1`: TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E4.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Unable to view images in reports in PDF/Excel output when using Report Studio/Workspace. 
However images are visible in HTML format when reports are run actively.
- `E4.S3`: SYMPTOM
Unable to view images in reports in PDF/Excel output when using Report Studio/Workspace. 
However images are visible in HTML format when reports are run actively.
- `E4.S4`: The PDF/Excel outputs will have a placeholder image. This will be in the form of an empty black box (PDF) or will be a missing pictures icon (Excel).
- `E4.S5`: CAUSE
There are a few common causes for this issue:
- `E4.S6`: 1. The permissions of the folder which contains the image, have not been configured correctly 
 2. The image is not within the directory which is specified 
 3. The directory where the image is meant to be stored, does not exist in the specified location
- `E4.S7`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
To find out the root cause of this problem, you will need to use tools that monitor and record all actions attempted against the Operating System Registry.
- `E4.S8`: In THIS scenario the tool used was Process Monitor and the Web Server was IIS 7.5.
- `E4.S9`: 1.  Download Process Monitor tool (Make sure you run it from the same machine Cognos is installed on) 
 2.  Open up the report in Cognos Workspace 
 3.  Load up Process Monitor 
 4.  You will notice the current processes immediately being captured and displaying in the window. Press the Capture / Ctrl+E Icon (Magnifying Glass) to stop the capture of events. 
 5.  Press the Clear / Ctrl+X icon (Eraser) to remove all the recorded entries. 
 6.  Press the capture icon in process monitor 
 7.  Export the report to Excel 2007/PDF 
 8.  Save the file anywhere 
 9.  Press the Capture icon again in process monitor to stop the capturing of events. 
 10. Press the Find Icon / Ctrl+F and type "[Image Name]" to make sure the filter image event was captured. 
 11. You should be able to see the reason why the image could not be saved under the 'Result' column.
- `E4.S10`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
If the image is found but cannot be accessed due to permission configuration issue:
- `E4.S11`: 1. Open up IIS 7.5 
 2. Click on the root folder of your Cognos installation (E.g. C1021GA) in the navigation pane on the left side 
 3. When the root folder is selected, double-click 'Authentication' 
 4. Ensure that anonymous access is enabled 
 5. Repeat steps 3 and 4 for the image folder and it's parent folder. 
 6. If the user is concerned about security, they may want to restrict the child-folders (E.g. cgi-bin) and change the authentication settings accordingly 
 7. Run the report in export as Excel 2007 and PDF
- `E4.S12`: If the image/ directory is not located:
- `E4.S13`: Place the image/directory in the specified location
- `E4.S14`: Cross reference information Segment Product Component Platform Version Edition Business Analytics Cognos Business Intelligence Cognos Workspace Windows 10.2.1, 10.2
- `E5.S1`: TECHNOTE (FAQ)
- `E5.S2`: QUESTION
 Does IBM Cognos Analysis for Microsoft Excel, Planning Analytics for Microsoft Excel, or TM1 Perspectives support Microsoft Office 365?
- `E5.S3`: CAUSE
You can check the supported environments for all versions of Cognos Analysis for Microsoft Excel, Planning Analytics for Microsoft Excel, or Perspectives on the IBM website:
https://www.ibm.com/software/reports/compatibility/clarity/index.html [https://www.ibm.com/software/reports/compatibility/clarity/index.html]
- `E5.S4`: However, MS Office 365 is not a 'traditional' single product. Instead, it is a subscription plan which allows users to download/run the very latest version of Office. In other words, customers who own Office 365 licenses will probably be upgrading their Excel versions (over time) as new MS Excel versions are released.
=> This makes it impossible to give a simple 'yes/no' answer to the question to whether Cognos Analysis for Microsoft Excel or Planning Analytics for Microsoft Excel supports MS Office 365.
- `E5.S5`: ANSWER
Microsoft Office 365 is supported so long as all of the following are true:
- `E5.S6`: * The version of Office installed (for example Office 2016) as part of Office 365, is supported by that version of Cognos Analysis for Microsoft Excel or Planning Analytics for Microsoft Excel. For example:  * Cognos Analysis for Microsoft Excel 10.2.2 FP6 is the first release in that line that supports Excel 2016. All earlier versions of CAFE 10.2.2 (FP5 and earlier) support a maximum of Office 2013. 
    * Planning Analytics for Microsoft Excel has supported Excel 2016 since its release.
- `E5.S7`: * Using desktop-installed (downloaded) Office 365 (not the cloud version of Office 365), which has been installed via the traditional installation method or if you have installed via click to run.
- `E5.S8`: ========================================
- `E5.S9`: For the avoidance of doubt, Office 365 is not supported when running directly in the Cloud (instead of running on the desktop/laptop directly).
- `E5.S10`: ========================================
- `E5.S11`: Q1 - What are the different methods to install Microsoft Office 365?
Microsoft Office 365 can be installed in two different ways:
- `E5.S12`: (1) Traditional method
- `E5.S13`: * This is sometimes called the 'MSI' or 'Windows Installer' method 
 * It is also sometimes known as the 'Volume License' method 
 * The application is installed (and runs) natively/directly on the users client device
- `E5.S14`: (2) Click-to-run  * The user "streams" the portion of Office that they need (downloading extra portions as and when they need it). The software is running in an isolated 'Sandbox' environment ('virtual bubble') on the computer.
- `E5.S15`: Q2 - What is 'Click to Run' ? 
Click-to-Run is a streaming and virtualization technology that is designed to significantly reduce the time that is required to download and use Office client products. Streaming allows users to begin to use a Click-to-Run product before the complete product is downloaded.
- `E5.S16`: Click-to-Run for Office 365 products are based on core virtualization and streaming Microsoft Application Virtualization ( App-V) technologies. Click-to-Run resources run in an isolated virtual environment on the local operating system.
- `E5.S17`: Q3 - How can I check if my installation is 'traditional' or 'click to run'? 
 * Method #1 (recommended)
- `E5.S18`: 1. Launch Excel (or Outlook or Word). 
2. Click "File - Account" (or Office Account). 
[/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22015168&aid=1] [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22015168&aid=1] 
- If you see an " Update Options" item, you have a Click-to-Run installation 
- If you don't see the "Update Options" item, you have an MSI-based install.
- `E5.S19`: resources run in an isolated virtual environment on the local operating system.
- `E5.S20`: Q3 - How can I check if my installation is 'traditional' or 'click to run'? 
 * Method #1 (recommended)
- `E5.S21`: 1. Launch Excel (or Outlook or Word). 
2. Click "File - Account" (or Office Account). 
[/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22015168&aid=1] [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22015168&aid=1] 
- If you see an " Update Options" item, you have a Click-to-Run installation 
- If you don't see the "Update Options" item, you have an MSI-based install.
- `E5.S22`: * Method #2 (alternative)
- `E5.S23`: See where EXCEL.EXE is installed/run from:
- `E5.S24`: (1) Traditional (MSI): 
By default, EXCEL.EXE is located in the following locations:  * Office 2013 (32-bit): C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\Office15\ 
 * Office 2016 (32-bit): C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\
- `E5.S25`: (2) Click to Run: 
By default, EXCEL.EXE is located in the following locations:  * Office 2013 (32-bit): C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office 15\ClientX64\Root\Office15\ 
 * Office 2016 (32-bit): C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office 16\ClientX64\Root\Office16\
- `E5.S26`: Q4 - What should I do if I have already installed MS Office 365 as 'click to run', and it is unsupported in my version of Cognos Analysis for Microsoft Excel or Planning Analytics for Microsoft Excel ? 
Either: 
(a) Remove the Click-To-Run installed Office. Then install MS Office via the traditional (MSI) method instead 
or (b) Upgrade to a later version of Cognos Analysis for Microsoft Excel or Planning Analytics for Microsoft Excel which supports click to run (see above for caveats).

- `E5.S1`: v6Rnotes; v601rnotes TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E5.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 When WebSphere Application Server attempts to recover Oracle database transactions, the following exception is issued:
- `E5.S3`: WTRN0037W: The transaction service encountered an error on an xa_recover operation. The resource was com.ibm.ws.rsadapter.spi.WSRdbXaResourceImpl@1114a62. The error code was XAER_RMERR. The exception stack trace follows: javax.transaction.xa.XAException
at oracle.jdbc.xa.OracleXAResource.recover(OracleXAResource.java:726)
at com.ibm.ws.rsadapter.spi.WSRdbXaResourceImpl.recover(WSRdbXaResourceImpl.java:954)
at com.ibm.ws.Transaction.JTA.XARminst.recover(XARminst.java:137)
at com.ibm.ws.Transaction.JTA.XARecoveryData.recover(XARecoveryData.java:609)
at com.ibm.ws.Transaction.JTA.PartnerLogTable.recover(PartnerLogTable.java:511)
at com.ibm.ws.Transaction.JTA.RecoveryManager.resync(RecoveryManager.java:1784)
at com.ibm.ws.Transaction.JTA.RecoveryManager.run(RecoveryManager.java:2241)
- `E5.S4`: CAUSE
Oracle requires that you have special permissions to attempt to perform the recovery.
If there is a system crash during a distributed transaction, the WebSphere Application Server transaction manager will attempt to clean up any failed transactions which it finds in the transaction logs. 
When the recovery involves an Oracle XAResource, the Oracle JDBC driver 
oracle.jdbc.xa.OracleXAResource.recover function will make a call to DIST_TXN_SYNC.
- `E5.S5`: The above error occurs when the user trying to execute the .recover method does not have sufficient privileges to make a call to DIST_TXN_SYNC.
- `E5.S6`: ENVIRONMENT
This problem can occur with all versions of Oracle: 10g, 11g, and 12g.
- `E5.S7`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
Run the following commands as user SYS:
- `E5.S8`: grant select on pending_trans$ to <user>; 
grant select on dba_2pc_pending to <user>;
grant select on dba_pending_transactions to <user>;
grant execute on dbms_system to <user>; (If using Oracle 10.2.0.3 or lower JDBC driver)
grant execute on dbms_xa to <user>; (If using Oracle 10.2.0.4 or higher JDBC driver)
- `E5.S9`: Where <user> is the username configured in the Oracle datasource's authentication alias.
- `E5.S10`: This problem is mentioned under Oracle bug: 3979190. Running the preceding commands solve the problem.
- `E5.S11`: Update: Since the SYS.DBMS_SYSTEM package contains many procedures, granting execute privileges to that package gives access to all of them. In Oracle patch 5892995 (JDBC driver) and 5945463 (server), Oracle has moved the DIST_TXN_SYNC procedure to a new package called DBMS_XA. These patches are available in 10.2.0.4 and higher. By using the new DBMS_XA package, it will reduce the security risk which DBMS_SYSTEM might cause.
- `E5.S12`: If the recovery of the inflight transactions is not important, then one possible workaround to this problem is to remove the transaction logs. (Does NOT apply to WebSphere Process Server and IBM Business Process Manager, please see note below for details)
- `E5.S13`: The transaction logs are stored in the following folder:
<WebSphere Application Server_install_root>\profiles\<PROFILE_NAME>\tranlog\<CELL_NAME>\<NODE_NAME>\<SERVER_NAME>\transaction
- `E5.S14`: To remove the transaction logs, do the following:
(1) Stop the server.
(2) Delete the '\transaction' folder and all subdirectories.
(3) Restart the server. 
The above exceptions will no longer occur.
- `E5.S15`: NOTE: Transaction logs should NOT be deleted if running in a WebSphere Process Server or IBM Business Process Manager environment. 
The WebSphere Process Server and IBM Business Process Manager systems can get into an inconsistent state because the logs are tightly coupled with information in other places like BPEDB, WPSDB, SIB messages and MQ, if it is configured.
- `E5.S16`: If WebSphere Process Server or IBM Business Process Manager is being used, follow the information in this document:
- `E5.S17`: How to resolve Transaction- and Partnerlog recovery issues in WebSphere Process Server (WPS) and IBM Business Process Manager (BPM)
https://developer.ibm.com/answers/questions/168157/how-to-resolve-transaction-and-partnerlog-recovery.html [https://developer.ibm.com/answers/questions/168157/how-to-resolve-transaction-and-partnerlog-recovery.html]
- `E5.S18`: RELATED INFORMATION
 A simplified Chinese translation is available [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21621220]
- `E5.S19`: is configured.
- `E5.S20`: If WebSphere Process Server or IBM Business Process Manager is being used, follow the information in this document:
- `E5.S21`: How to resolve Transaction- and Partnerlog recovery issues in WebSphere Process Server (WPS) and IBM Business Process Manager (BPM)
https://developer.ibm.com/answers/questions/168157/how-to-resolve-transaction-and-partnerlog-recovery.html [https://developer.ibm.com/answers/questions/168157/how-to-resolve-transaction-and-partnerlog-recovery.html]

## techqa_DEV_Q174#row-0049

Question:
Datacap on Citrix  Hi All,

Can we operate Datacap thin clients on citrix?


Reference / gold answer:
Based on the provided context, Datacap thin clients can be operated on Citrix. However, it is mentioned that IBM has not tested or sought certification with Citrix, and does not provide support for Citrix. If any issues are encountered while deploying Datacap clients on Citrix, IBM may require you to reproduce the issues outside of Citrix as part of the investigation.

Reference evidence:
- `4b`:  What are the best practices for deploying Datacap servers and clients on a wide area network (WAN)? ANSWER
- `4c`: Remote users that access Datacap over a WAN can use Taskmaster Web-based "thin clients", or FastDoc Capture operating in offline mode.
- `4d`: Datacap thick clients (DotScan, DotEdit) and utilities (NENU, Fingerprint Maintenance Tool) require LAN communication speeds and low latency for responsive performance.
- `4g`: Some customers successfully operate Datacap thick clients in remote sites using Citrix or other remote access technology.
- `4h`: IBM has not tested or sought certification with Citrix, and does not provide support for Citrix.
- `4i`: If you deploy Datacap clients on Citrix and encounter issues, IBM may require you to reproduce the issues outside of Citrix as part of the investigation.
